name: Talent
desc: Every skill’s effects grow by 0.01% × rank × the skill’s highest level at any past prestige × prestiges performed.

name: Endowment
desc: Every attribute grows by 0.01% × rank × its highest trained level at any past prestige × prestiges performed.

name: Provisions
desc: +50 gold at the start of every run, per rank.

name: Chronosense ceiling
desc: Chronosense can reach 5 levels higher, per rank.

name: Weathersense ceiling
desc: Weathersense can reach 5 levels higher, per rank.

name: Darkvision ceiling
desc: Darkvision can reach 10 levels higher, per rank.

name: Foresight
desc: Locked skills and upcoming milestones are shown with their requirements at any progress. Without it they appear only at 90% of the requirement.

name: Wayfinding
desc: Go buttons outside town: quest givers and objectives anywhere on the map, and a Trains at list on each skill and attribute with a button for every discovered place that trains it (that activity starts on arrival). Without it: town places have Go buttons on the Quests tab, and places you have worked at have a station in the Stations row above the map.

name: Head Start
desc: Every run starts 1 character level higher, per rank: +1 to every attribute per level. Never lowers a level already reached.

name: Key to the City
desc: Opens band 3, the city (floors 7 to 10), on this run and every later one. Floors 1 to 6 must still be cleared first, or passed.

name: Pass: the Lower Reaches
desc: Floors 1 to 3 count as cleared on this run and every later one, so the climb starts at floor 4. Passed floors pay no clear XP and no harvest points.

name: Pass: the Wilds
desc: Floors 4 to 6 count as cleared on this run and every later one. Passed floors pay no clear XP and no harvest points. The warchief still waits on floor 6, and prestige opens only when it is killed.

name: Cook's Notes
desc: The Cook’s Book resets with each run; the notes keep part of it. Rank 1: dishes you cooked 25 times keep their cook time shown. Rank 2: dishes you cooked 100 times also keep their Signature. The cook counts themselves still reset.
